voiceover_script: My heart had twelve beats left before the brand turned my lungs to ash. And the High Executioner of House Veyr stood ready to collect every single one. Lower your head, Ashford. A dying heart cannot even lift a blade. You forgot the first law of the Cinder Brand, Malakor. A dying ember burns twice as hot right before it goes out. Two heartbeats vanished into the ash. Ten remained on the clock. Cut him down! Do not let that blade wake! Way too slow. The shockwave tore through three centuries of Tribunal stone in half a second. High Executioner Malakor hit the stone before his shattered halberd did. Then the cracked floor beneath my boots answered with a pulse of its own. Something buried beneath House Veyr just matched my tenth heartbeat.
caption: The Knight With Twelve Heartbeats Left
